name: okf
description: Be the expert on Open Knowledge Format (OKF) — portable project knowledge as a directory of markdown files with YAML frontmatter that humans and agents read from one source. Use when capturing knowledge into a bundle (a service, schema, metric, decision, runbook: "document this in OKF", "capture this as a concept"), converting existing docs into one ("migrate/OKFy our docs into a bundle"), retrieving from one without reading it whole ("what do we know about X?", "where is X documented?", "search the bundle"), updating one after code or docs change ("update the knowledge bundle"), checking its conformance or curation quality ("validate/lint the bundle"), serving or rendering it as a graph, or working in a repo that already carries an OKF bundle — a `.okf/` directory or a root `index.md` carrying `okf_version`.
